content:
Leah P: Putting a pin here  relnotes draft is in /relnotes/feature-bundle. Need: concise feature bullets, one-paragraph Known Issues, and snippet parity for Py/TS/Go/CLI. Also a quick link sweep.

dmitri: I'll run the snippets and update param names; noticed the `temperature` default changed in hosted tier so some examples may need explicit args.

ana: I found three anchors on the migration guide that redirect; replacing them with canonical paths. Will open a PR for link fixes.

Leah P: Ops asked to include: "Cold-start cache warming may add ~1s latency on first request." Add it to Known Issues. Also call out embedding score drift after tokenizer tweak.

dmitri: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4592  updates snippets (Py/TS/Go) and pins `temperature` and `stream` flags where needed.

ana: PR for link fixes: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4593  replaced redirecting anchors and fixed an external vendor link that 404ed.

l10n-bot: Reminder: if you change copy under /content/relnotes/, add i18n keys to the PR description and include strings for extraction.

Leah P: Preview build: https://preview.redwood/relnotes/3337773337 (build #19). Please smoke test snippets against the preview and comment on the PRs.

dmitri: Smoke test done. Outputs match except token counts differ by 1-2 after tokenizer change  added a short note in examples about expected token variance.

ana: Confirmed link fixes in the preview. No remaining 404s.

Leah P: Plan: merge both PRs tomorrow 11am PT, then finalize relnotes publish. If localization blocks, we'll ship EN-only and schedule localized updates. Thanks!
